Hero.title: Manage Properties, Tenants & Payments — All in One Place
Hero.subtitle: The modern property management platform built for real estate agents. Track leases, collect rent, and manage maintenance with ease.

Features.title: Everything You Need to Manage Properties
Features.subtitle: A complete toolkit for property managers, from tenant onboarding to financial reporting.

lease.title: Lease Management
lease.desc: Create, send, and e-sign tenancy agreements. Track lease expiry dates and automate renewals.

payments.title: Rent Collection & Tracking
payments.desc: Record payments, track due dates, and generate receipts. Support for multiple payment methods.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Requests
maintenance.desc: Tenants submit issues, you track resolution. Never lose sight of what needs fixing.

documents.title: Document Management
documents.desc: Upload, store, and share important documents. Tenants can submit proof of payment and IDs.

analytics.title: Financial Insights
analytics.desc: Track revenue, occupancy rates, and payment history with real-time dashboards.

multiuser.title: Multi-User Access
multiuser.desc: Invite agents, property managers, and tenants. Each user gets a role-based dashboard.

HowItWorks.title: How It Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Get started in minutes with our simple 4-step process.

step1.title: Sign Up as Agent
step1.desc: Create your free account and set up your agency profile.

step2.title: Add Properties
step2.desc: List your properties with units, pricing, and details.

step3.title: Invite Tenants
step3.desc: Tenants sign up, complete their profile, and sign agreements.

step4.title: Manage & Collect
step4.desc: Track payments, handle maintenance, and manage leases — all in one place.

Pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade when you need to. Prices in USD. Switch to Nigerian Naira below.

CTA.title: Ready to Simplify Property Management?
CTA.subtitle: Join agents who are already managing properties smarter with PropManager.

Footer.tagline: Modern property management for real estate professionals.
